acceptedScope: OQ8 design reference, invariant crosswalk, landed-source identity, architecture boundaries, and source-only handoff
findings: The exact review subject and limitation bodies match their recorded hashes; all twelve subject bindings, the validator identity and requirements, and all four reviewed public-document hashes resolve to the current bound bytes.

Landed source 5e8f175b2ced4715f7c6f765386812cc1001dbb4 is a real commit with tree 96fdfbba56df41b58889bf7f3b532a64d15314bd and is an ancestor of HEAD; replacement-ref-isolated Git reads preserve the immutable identity proof.

All 26 captured capability-path identities match the landed commit, and all five declared capture-to-landed overrides are exact and explained, including DaprTestContainerFixture.cs 0da109af79cb0ded1c9e7377c4140a561ef682f1cf23b7c0fbb6284b7401c216 to 28a89849a864014f4e18ab0bd791c4e905cc662799c8a58fce7e9627762dde9a.

The 24 non-evolved paths are byte-identical between landed source and HEAD, have normal index flags, and have neither semantic worktree nor staged changes; only integration.yml and the closure validator are explicitly evolved at current HEAD.

The OQ8-1 through OQ8-8 crosswalk is complete and approved across Stories 4.9 through 4.14; all nine crosswalk evidence bindings and all seven immutable capture-manifest artifacts verify, preserving the production and deterministic evidence boundary.

Architecture and authority boundaries are coherent: test seams enter shipped Release binaries only through a test-assembly HostingStartup under Testing, docs repeat the source-only install and verification boundary, and every external operational-authority field remains false.
